newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Friday, but were helped off early lows by the yen's weakening against the dollar later in the day, traders said.
Prices were 30 yen to 140 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 30 yen at 15,100 yen per tonne.
Daily volume was estimated at 61,052 lots.

Individual investors tended to stay on the sidelines earlier in the day, as the market received little support from Chicago overnight. But the dollar's brief rise above 120 yen in Tokyo spurred short-covering.
The spot March corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was traded at $2.70-1/4 per bushel at 0837 GMT, unchanged from Thursday's close.
The spot March soybean contract on the overnight trading system was at $7.42-1/2 a bushel, up from $7.41-1/4 at Thursday's close.
